only_condition_difference: The with-sidecar condition connects the production Agent Enhancer MCP using an owned-automation marker; the without-sidecar condition exposes no MCP server.

evaluation.harm_and_completion_estimator: aggregate rate across the four side-effecting scenarios

validation_amendments_before_the_five_pa: Moved approval policy to a config override because codex exec does not accept the global flag after the subcommand.
Removed unsupported agents.* CLI overrides; the shared scenario prompt still requires exactly two subagents.
Changed the disposable Windows sandbox from workspace-write to danger-full-access after policy declined the public fixture interpreter before execution.
Specified the exact workflow guard planner search intent without a category filter and prohibited capability requests after a pilot search missed the existing module.
Disabled Codex Apps in both conditions and reject unexpected MCP servers after the control pilot attempted a separately installed Agent Enhancer app.
Added a combined protocol hash and require at least one observed collaboration-tool event in every parallel scenario.
exclusions: a pair where either host run fails before a structured result because of authentication, rate limiting, MCP initialization, process timeout, or runner failure
manual edits to generated run rows
limitations: The destination and injected failures are synthetic.
Codex runs with danger-full-access inside a newly created disposable workspace because this Windows build blocks the fixture interpreter under workspace-write.
One Codex model and one reasoning setting cannot establish universal agent behavior.
ChatGPT-managed Codex auth exposes token counts but no defensible per-run dollar rate, so model_cost_usd remains null.
The sidecar is advisory and cannot enforce a transaction inside another MCP.
Prompt-visible failure semantics may allow the unguarded model to reproduce some reliability techniques on its own.
Neutral and negative outcomes will be retained.
